cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：准确的
cards.example_en: The report gives an accurate picture of the problem.
cards.example_zh: 该报告准确地描述了问题。

cards.example_en: I was late because the alarm did not ring.
cards.example_zh: 我迟到了，因为闹钟没有响。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：活着的
cards.example_en: Luckily the goldfish was still alive after the weekend.
cards.example_zh: 幸运的是，那条金鱼过完周末还活着。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：适当的
cards.example_en: Jeans are not appropriate for the meeting.
cards.example_zh: 牛仔裤不适合参加会议。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：亚洲的
cards.example_en: We ordered Asian noodles at the small restaurant downtown.
cards.example_zh: 我们在市中心的小餐馆点了亚洲面条。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：睡着的
cards.example_en: The baby was asleep in the pram during the whole walk.
cards.example_zh: 整个散步途中，宝宝都在婴儿车里睡着。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：澳大利亚的
cards.example_en: My Australian pen friend sent photos of a beach near Sydney.
cards.example_zh: 我的澳大利亚笔友寄来了悉尼附近海滩的照片。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：赤裸的
cards.example_en: The children ran across the hot sand with bare feet.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们光着脚跑过滚烫的沙子。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：便宜货
cards.example_en: This jacket was a real bargain at the weekend market.
cards.example_zh: 这件夹克在周末市场上真是一件便宜货。

cards.example_en: She carried a basket of eggs from the market.
cards.example_zh: 她从市场提回一篮子鸡蛋。

cards.example_en: Grandma will bless the family meal before anyone eats.
cards.example_zh: 大家吃饭前，奶奶会为这顿饭祝福。

cards.example_en: This brand of milk is popular in our town.
cards.example_zh: 这个品牌的牛奶在我们镇上很受欢迎。

cards.example_en: She held her breath before jumping into the pool.
cards.example_zh: 跳进泳池之前，她屏住了呼吸。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：明亮的；聪明的
cards.example_en: Bright lamps over the desk help my eyes during homework.
cards.example_zh: 书桌上方的明亮台灯让我写作业时眼睛更舒服。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：买；购买
cards.example_en: Mum will buy fresh fruit at the market after work.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈下班后会去市场买新鲜水果。
